shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -C 4 -i 'table' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo ---- SRC && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- EVAL && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60 && echo ---- TRAPS && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table Pagination withTableSorting withTableSelection withTableSettings Text 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---- ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc 2>/dev/null

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table Pagination withTableSorting withTableSelection 2>&1 | head -40; echo ---- TABLE.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; echo ---- SORT; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; echo ---- SELECT; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; echo ---- PAGINATION; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/

rg -n 'meta|sort|defaultSortOrder' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -40; echo ---- SEL; rg -n 'getRowId|selectedIds|disabled|Checkbox' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -30; echo ---- EXPORTS; rg -n 'Table|Pagination' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts

sed -n 36,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; rg -n 'export declare const Label|export interface LabelProps|theme\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head; rg -n 'variant' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && git status --short
